LITERATURE IN ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: LITERATURE IN ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only an action
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a describing word
   D. Only a joining word

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. went
   B. goed
   C. goes
   D. going

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fiction: Novel from Kenya - Features of prose fiction - The Author - The plot - .

8. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Poetry 2.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry Types of poems: - Free verse - Blank verse -.

12. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Literature 1.1.1 Introduction to Oral Literature - Definition - Genres/ Cla.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Poetry 3.2.1 Appreciation of Poetry - Categories of poems - Process of writing a; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fiction and Non- Fiction 3.3.1 Fiction: The Novel from Kenya -Themes -The Novel ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fiction: The Novel from Kenya -Themes -The Novel and history of Kenya -The Novel; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fiction and Non- Fiction 3.3.2 Non- Fiction: Personal Journal -Language and styl; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
